extraction.documentCompletenessNote: Bundled fictional solicitation document with all sections present.
extraction.scopeSummary: Routine commercial office cleaning at three federal offices in Halifax, Truro and Kentville, Nova Scotia, for a two-year initial term. Includes nightly cleaning, waste and recycling removal, floor care, and supply of products and equipment.

deadlines.label: Questions due
deadlines.value: Seven calendar days before the closing date
deadlines.sourceExcerpt: Questions must be submitted in writing no later than seven calendar days before the closing date.

deadlines.label: Bid closing
deadlines.value: As stated in the tender notice
deadlines.sourceExcerpt: The closing date and time are stated in the tender notice. Late proposals will not be accepted.

requirements.description: Provide 60 weekly labour hours of commercial office cleaning in Halifax
requirements.sourceExcerpt: Halifax: The contractor must provide 60 labour hours weekly of commercial office cleaning at the Halifax office

requirements.description: Provide 20 weekly labour hours of commercial office cleaning in Truro
requirements.sourceExcerpt: Truro: The contractor must provide 20 labour hours weekly of commercial office cleaning at the Truro office

requirements.description: Provide 15 weekly labour hours of commercial office cleaning in Kentville
requirements.sourceExcerpt: Kentville: The contractor must provide 15 labour hours weekly of commercial office cleaning at the Kentville office

requirements.description: Every proposed delivery company, including subcontractors, must evidence a valid CleanSafe Level 2 certification
requirements.sourceExcerpt: Each proposed delivery company, including any subcontractor, must provide evidence of a valid CleanSafe Level 2 certification with its proposal.

requirements.description: The bidder (prime contractor) must hold commercial general liability insurance of at least $2,000,000
requirements.sourceExcerpt: The bidder must hold commercial general liability insurance of at least $2,000,000 and provide a certificate of insurance before contract award.

requirements.description: Subcontractors must be named in the proposal and approved in writing by the buyer before award
requirements.sourceExcerpt: Subcontracting is permitted only where the bidder names each proposed subcontractor in its proposal and the Contracting Authority provides written approval of each named subcontractor before contract award.

requirements.description: Use of certified green cleaning products (up to 20 points)
requirements.sourceExcerpt: Use of certified green cleaning products: up to 20 points.

requirements.description: Relevant experience cleaning office buildings in the last five years (up to 30 points)
requirements.sourceExcerpt: Relevant experience cleaning office buildings in the last five years: up to 30 points.

extraction.partnershipExcerpt: Subcontracting is permitted only where the bidder names each proposed subcontractor in its proposal and the Contracting Authority provides written approval of each named subcontractor before contract award.
partnershipConditions: Each subcontractor must be named in the proposal
Buyer must approve each named subcontractor in writing before award
The bidder remains solely responsible as prime contractor
extraction.jointVentureNote: The solicitation does not address joint ventures or consortium bids (Section 4.3); subcontracting permission does not imply joint-venture permission.
unknowns: Buyer approval of any named subcontractor is not yet obtained
Whether a joint venture would be accepted is not addressed
